Class J2dEntityFactory

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d.J2dEntityFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityFactory
public class J2dEntityFactory extends Object implements EntityFactory
Concrete factory — the Java2D implementation of EntityFactory.

This class is the other half of the Abstract Factory pattern: EntityFactory is the interface (in game.factory) and J2dEntityFactory is the concrete implementation (in j2d).

Responsibilities: it creates the J2dGame window (the visualization layer) from the config; every create method returns a J2d* entity (which extends an abstract game-logic class and implements render() with Graphics2D) typed as the abstract interface so game logic never sees J2d; and getView() provides the GameView interface to Game, keeping the game/visualization separation intact.

Wiring: Main creates a J2dEntityFactory(config) and passes it to Game.start(). The factory builds the window internally and provides all entity creation; the game logic only sees EntityFactory and GameView.
